slug: 2026-07-10 Nigeria tests data sovereignty as foreign tech firms facing probe

facts.fact: Nigeria's data centre industry has about 26 facilities, 18 of them commercial, with 50-56 MW live capacity and 124 MW installed, per the Nigerian Tribune report of 2026-07-10.
Rack Centre in Lagos is operating and reports 100 percent uptime via off-grid gas power.
Open Access Data Centres CEO Ayotunde Coker highlights the operator's Tier-III facilities in Nigeria; a statement by the operator, no certifier or facility named, article dated 2026-07-10.

note: Foreign hyperscalers are said to host Nigerian data but no cloud region in Nigeria is stated, so no cloud fact. CBN onshoring mandate by 2027-01-01 is policy.
